Trust boundary: an email that says “paid” is still not money. PactSignal changes the received total only after independent confirmation, and every result opens back to the exact correspondence.
Privacy and control

In the downloadable local application, mailbox analysis, SQLite storage and the bundled model run locally. This public overview is a precomputed fictional export; it does not import your mailbox. The core works with outbound network disabled. PactSignal never sends mail or moves money. Choose the mailbox folder or Gmail query you connect; remove the selected local database to delete the imported workspace. No telemetry is included in this build.

CLIENT CASE · ST-24

Rowan · Catalogue photography

Email · Telegram · WhatsApp · Internal handover

Owner: Nina · Latest update 12:00 · 5 linked events
Verify payment
AGREED300.00 EUR
CLIENT SAYS SENT300.00 EUR
CONFIRMED RECEIVED0.00 EUR
RESPONSIBLENina
NEXT ACTION · NINACheck independent receipt evidence before marking the payment received.

Current agreement

10 images · EUR 300 · Friday delivery

The extra 20 images and Thursday delivery were proposed, never approved, then withdrawn. Nina now owns the case.

Original agreement ↓ · Latest scope confirmation ↓

Unified history · 5 events · oldest first
  1. 09:00EmailClient · Rowan

    Agreement confirmed

    10 images · EUR 300 · Friday. This is the agreed scope.

    Read source message
    For order ST-24, I approve the 10-image package for EUR 300, delivery Friday.
  2. 10:15TelegramClient · Rowan

    Change proposed — not approved

    20 extra images and Thursday delivery are a request only. Original terms remain in force.

    Read source message
    Regarding ST-24: could we have 20 more images and delivery Thursday instead? Please quote first; the extra work is not approved.
  3. 11:00Internal handoverTeam lead

    Responsibility transferred

    Nina replaces Alex. The agreement stays unchanged; the pending request must be reviewed.

    Read source message
    Alex is unavailable. Nina takes responsibility for ST-24. Please review the email agreement and pending chat request before responding.
  4. 11:20WhatsAppClient · Rowan

    Payment claimed — not confirmed

    Client says EUR 300 was sent. No independent receipt is present; confirmed received remains EUR 0.

    Read source message
    ST-24: I sent the EUR 300 payment. Can you check?
  5. 12:00EmailClient · Rowan

    Extra work withdrawn

    The client keeps the original 10 images and Friday delivery. No extra work is authorised.

    Read source message
    For ST-24, keep the original 10 images and Friday delivery. Do not add the 20 images.

Why these messages belong together: explicit case reference ST-24 and a predefined demo identity mapping. Names alone are not used to merge conversations. Fictional example; no live messenger connection.
